In article <4lrapv$bb1@newsbf02.news.aol.com>,
Smerdyakv <smerdyakv@aol.com> wrote:
>
>Note that the Unabomber wants everyone to join him -- that is, everyone
>except leftists --  in working toward his goals:
>
>"a movement that exalts nature and opposes technology take a resolutely
>anti-leftist stance and must avoid all collaboration with leftists."
>(para. 214)

Alas, it's the left that has embraced the environmental movement, and
the conservatives who are liberal with land use issues. They label
the environmentalists as leftist, and don't want to be reminded that
Theodore Roosevelt was a champion of "conservation".

headers.Subject: Re: Vice President Algore's ideas fueled the unabomber!! NOT!
